question:
On the basis of the logic used in the first pair, select from the substitute alternate question mark in the second pair.

Contract : Agreement :: Oath : ??
solution:
**The logic is as followed,**

 
• In the first pair we are given that,

 
 
• First word is the "Contract".
 
• Second word is "agreement" which is a **synonym of the contract.**
 
• So, the pair is **"Contract: Agreement".**
 
 
 
• In the second pair,
 
 
• First word is the "Oath".
 
• We know that **"****Promise"** is a **synonym for Oath.**
 
• And Promise is the only word that relates out of the given options.
 
• So, the second pair is "Oath: Promise".
 
 

Hence, Oath : Promise is the correct answer.
